rules.text: Fixed pedestals: 15 1/4"W x 27"H, 22"D and 28"D. Mobile pedestals with steel top: 15 1/4"W, 22"D, 21"H and 26 5/8"H. Mobile with seat cushion: 22 1/2"D, 22 3/4"H, 15 1/4"W (16 1/4"W with handle). Bins: 15 3/4"D x 16 1/4"H, 24/30/36/42/48/60/72"W. Laminate common shelves: 15"D x 7 3/4"H, 24–48"W. Under-worksurface lateral files: 18 1/8"D x 27"H, 30 1/2"W and 36"W. Tower Too 24"D x 24"W, 48"H (open side shelving only), 54"H, 66"H. TS 200 lateral files 18"D, 30/36/42"W x 28/40/52/65 1/2"H.
For the full Universal Storage offering, see Storage Specification Guide.

Lock is standard keyed random and controls all drawers. Lock cylinders must be specified separately; products with locks ship with lock face ring and removable plastic plug for site-installed cylinder. Consecutive, specific and master-keyed options available (page 726).

Top of fixed pedestal is open to attach beneath the worksurface; finished back and sides standard; leveling glide range 1". Handle pull standard; ledge pulls optional; extra handle pull optional on mobile pedestals.
Pedestal file drawer accommodates letter- and legal-size filing; legal filing requires optional dividers/rails.

Mobile pedestals have different dividers that are not interchangeable with fixed pedestal accessories. Handle on mobile pedestal with seat cushion can be positioned in front or at rear; also available without handle. Cushions are 1 3/4" and upholstered with piping.
Box/box/file and file/file pedestals attach beneath 24"D and 30"D worksurfaces; attachment hardware provided. Mobile pedestal fits under 24"D and 30"D worksurfaces.
Dividers and pencil tray for mobile pedestals must be ordered separately (page 594); mobile pedestal accessories are not interchangeable with under-worksurface pedestal accessories.
Pedestal filler, ordered separately, fills gap between pedestal and panel; TS Series pedestal filler works with Kick panels only.
To file legal-size or side-to-side letter-size filing in pedestal file drawers, specify optional 15"W file rails.
Large (3/16" diameter) perforation is available as an option on mobile pedestal drawer fronts.
All pedestals ship with a factory-installed counterweight package. Counterweights are not required on TS Series fixed pedestals (page 590); mobile pedestals include counterweight package.
Pedestal: paint. Handle pull: 0835 Black, 9211 Nickel. Ledge pull: 4799 Platinum, 7207 Black. Lock: 9201 Polished Chrome. Cushion top: upholstery.
Under-worksurface pedestals shipped prior to January 2005 require the use of drawer accessories from the mobile pedestal collection.
File drawer rails are required to file legal-sized files or side-to-side letter-sized files in pedestal file drawers.
Two rails per drawer accommodate side-to-side filing of letter-, A4-, and legal-size hanging folders. Exception: Legal-size file folders cannot be filed in 18"D pedestals.
3"-diameter large front-locking casters (+$66) are available for box/file mobile pedestal TS2PBF22M only (steel top); also offered on seat cushion pedestals (page 593).
Extra handle pull on trim strip (+$33) is for mobile pedestals only.
TS2PBDD and TS2PFDD cannot be used with Turnstone under-worksurface pedestals. File drawer divider is required to file legal-sized files in (mobile) pedestal file drawers.
Mobile pedestals up to 24 1/2"H fit under 26"H tables and up to 27"H under 28 1/2"H tables without reinforcing channels; channels reduce space by 1" (Universal Tables page 236).
TS Series bins attach to Answer and Kick panels with integrated on-module hooks that mount on panels of the same width as the bin. Safety catch locks unit to frame.

Locks are standard on bins (factory-installed, keyed random only, under center of shelf); two-door units are keyed alike. Optional field-installed locks available with consecutive, specific and random keying; master-keyed also available; field-installed lock cylinders must be specified separately.
Bin is steel and ships assembled. Recess beneath unit accommodates a shelf light (page 332/689). Dividers optional, ship in package of four.
Additional support for stability may be required when overhead bins are attached to panels; counterbalancing loads on opposite sides of panels increases stability (Stability Guidelines page 124).
TS Series bins cannot be attached to upmount brackets (cannot be upmounted, page 595).
TS Series bins, Universal bins, and shelves can hang from the first stacked tier only.
Width of overhead bin must match the width of the panel or panels it is attached to. Bin may span up to two frames.

Wall channel horizontal brace is required with wall channels to support shelves and bins wider than 48". Wall channels attach bins to concrete/block walls, or wood/drywall/plaster if reinforced (page 288).

Clearance between Universal Systems worksurfaces or Universal tables and bottom of overhead bins is 21 3/8" when storage unit is installed in the highest position on a 66"H panel and glides are adjusted all the way into the panel.
Overhead bin height accepts standard and A4 binders. Bin finish: paint; lock 9201 Polished Chrome; dividers white plastic.
Flexible markerboard surfaces are offered for 30", 36", 42" and 48"W bin doors only.

Laminate common shelf has wood core covered with LPL or HPL; plastic edge band selectable; ships with steel support brackets that hook into vertical panel slots or wall channel with safety catch; brackets can be used in either orientation.
For anticipated heavy loads on 42" and 48"W laminate common shelves, a field-installed reinforcing channel (TSATRC39) can be used.
It is recommended that only worksurfaces of the same laminate type (LPL vs HPL) are specified in a given application.
Under-worksurface lateral file actual depth is 18 1/8"D, which will not accommodate the use of the 18"D Kick straight worksurfaces.
TS Series under-worksurface lateral files are only intended for use under a panel-mounted worksurface and should not be used as freestanding.

Lateral file drawers are standard with two side-to-side hanging file frames for letter or legal; clearance for two rows of filing. Top open to attach beneath worksurface; leveling glide range 1"; lock cylinders specified separately.
Large (3/16" diameter) perforation is available as an option on the 30 1/2"W under-worksurface lateral (TS2F230UL) only.
Accessories TS2FHF30/TS2FHF36, TS2FDV, TS2FFTBR are for use with TS2F230UL and TS2F236UL only; TS2FHF30 fits the 30 1/2"W (printed '31"W') file, TS2FHF36 the 36"W file.

Kick plate (2"H) and lock bar align with under-worksurface pedestal and Tower Too. Finishes: paint; handle pull 0835 Black / 9211 Nickel; ledge pull 4799 Platinum / 7207 Black; lock 9201 Polished Chrome.

Tower Too: finished top, sides and back; doors open 98°; shelves fixed; lock on lock bar secures file drawers; lock cylinders specified separately (specify lock cylinders for each lock location). Safety interlock allows only one drawer open at a time. Leveling glide range 3/4".

Tower Too drawers have full-height sides; hanging file frames not needed for front-to-back letter filing. Legal or side-to-side filing uses Universal filing rails RXADRL15. Box drawer dividers RDV1506, file drawer dividers RDV1512, pencil tray RPXDPT.
Contemporary pulls are available as unique Tower Too style numbers (C suffix).

Tower Too is available 48"H, 54"H, or 66"H; wardrobe storage can be left or right; 48"H is open side only. Open side shelving fixed shelves provide two openings with clearance of 5"H on 48"H, 12"H on 54"H and 18"H on 66"H units.
Wardrobe interior can be specified with wardrobe hook or wardrobe rod with shelf (style suffix S).
Two box drawers in place of top file drawer (+$185, box/box/file) available on 48"H, 54"H, and 66"H towers; box drawers have 3/4 extension.
Dome (TS2TDME) is field-installed only.
All locking (one lock for wardrobe, second for drawer, third for cabinet if applicable) available on 48"H, 54"H and 66"H towers: +$157 for units with cabinet, +$78 for open side units.
Counterweight package not required for any Tower Too.
TS 200 top is standard 1"H steel; label holders included; finished back standard; base 3"H integral; leveling glides adjust up to 7/8".

Lock is standard (factory-installed, keyed random) and secures all drawers and lift-up door. On 52"H and 65 1/2"H files lock is at top left corner of drawer third from the bottom; on 28"H and 40"H at top left corner of top drawer.

Drawers open full depth and are 12"H; one hanging folder bar per drawer for side-to-side filing of letter, A4 and legal. Alternative interiors (divider package, rails) apply to all drawers within a single lateral file. Additional bars specified separately (page 672).
Rail packages accommodate two rows of letter-size files in 30"W and 36"W drawers and three rows in 42"W drawers.
Divider packages include three dividers and one hanging folder bar per drawer.

Locks available factory- or field-installed. Factory-installed are standard and keyed random only. Field-installed locks available with consecutive, specific, and random keying; master-keyed available; field-installed lock cylinders must be specified separately.
Security top can be specified on 28"H files only; it is not structural; reduces overall height to approximately 27"H.
No-top lateral files are for installation under a worksurface or beneath a common top; hardware included; reduces height by 1" (–$92).
Laminate and wood veneer tops (square edge) are 1 3/16"H, 3/16" taller than steel tops, adding that dimension to overall height. Field-installed tops also available (page 668).

Lift-up door with fixed shelf is standard in the top position of 65 1/2"H cases; door is 13 1/2"H for standard-height binders and recedes inside the case. Optional roll-out shelf in place of fixed shelf (+$39, 65 1/2"H only). Roll-out shelf includes three dividers and one hanging file folder bar as backstop.
Safety interlock allows only one drawer or roll-out shelf to be opened at a time.

Counterweight packages must be specified as an option for lateral files that are not ganged to another case, attached to a worksurface, or bolted to the floor or wall. Counterweights can also be ordered separately (page 676), ship separately and must be field-installed. Recommended package per case is printed in the specification table.
Ganging hardware is included to join adjacent components side by side, back to back, or both.

Anchor bracket secures file/cabinet/tower to floor in seismic zones; four bracket packages are required for each cabinet. Anchor bracket cannot be used with pedestals. For California OSHPD approved anchor bracket contact Specials. Compliance with local seismic code is the customer's responsibility.

Finishes: case, steel top, drawer fronts, lift-up door, fixed shelf, pulls: paint. Wood veneer top: open pore finishes, Customiz stain (option). Laminate top: laminate, Open Line (option). Lock: 9201 Polished Chrome, 9250 Ember Chrome (option). Drawer bodies, roll-out shelves, hanging folder bars, rails, dividers: black.

Lift-up door units: all doors equipped with roll-out shelves; top door on 65 1/2"H is 13 1/2"H, all others 12"H for side-tab files; lock at top left corner of the top secures all lift-up doors; safety interlock allows only one roll-out shelf open at a time.
Each roll-out shelf includes one divider package (three dividers and one hanging folder bar) as backstop. Two hanging folder bars (no cost) replace the divider package when specified.
Other tops are field-installed only for lift-up door/roll-out shelf units (no factory top options on page 604).
Pedestals with TS 200 Series pulls are available — see Avenir Systems Furniture Specification Guide.
Furniture ships with plastic shipping plug; specify lock cylinder and keying separately. Only products with factory-installed lock mechanisms can accept lock cylinders in the field.

Step 1: order enough lock cylinders to fill each lock location and order a lock tool (tools are reusable; not needed with every order). Step 2: list total number of lock cylinders with style number; if specifying key numbers, list breakdown of quantity per key number.
For TS 200 Series specify a lock color number (9201 Polished Chrome or 9250 Ember Chrome) for the lock face ring.
All products are standard keyed random. If no key number is specified, locks are keyed random.

Key random: FR305–FR454 assigned arbitrarily (different units may share key numbers). Key specific: any key FR305–FR454. Key consecutive: beginning key FR305–FR454. Master key random/specific/consecutive: XF1001–XF1150, all openable with a master key (+$23 each).
If all locks must be keyed differently, specify key numbers for all locks.
Designate the quantity per key number when ordering more than one product with the same style number.

Lock price is included in price of furniture with locks; FR lock cylinders no cost, XF cylinders no additional cost (price included in furniture with master-keyed locks); lock tools $23 (standard 877102003SR for FR; master 877102002SR for XF).
Stability is assured only if units are properly installed and loaded. Units with roll-out components have an interlock system allowing only one drawer or roll-out shelf open at a time.
Gang unit with adjacent units (side-by-side or back-to-back) or bolt unit to floor or wall for stability; ganging hardware included with each unit.

Order a counterweight package option if recommended on specifying page and freestanding unit is not ganged to adjacent units or bolted to the floor or wall. Counterweight packages ship separately and are field-installed.
Load files starting with the bottom drawers or shelves; upper drawers or shelves should be loaded last; heaviest contents at the bottom.

Temporary peel-off caution label on front of top drawer/door; permanent caution label on left side of top drawer or roll-out shelf. Complete safe installation/use instructions (leveling, ganging, counter-balancing, removing/reinstalling drawers and shelves, moving files) are taped inside the unit.
Guidelines for Answer panel-hung components: see page 125.
